description: Colony control-plane throughput, model latency, token usage, cost, tools, HTTP health, and runtime saturation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(value) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.active_runs' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)

WITH samples AS (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((c, p) -> if(c >= p, toFloat64(c) - toFloat64(p), toFloat64(c)), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS deltas
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.run.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND now()
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT value FROM (
  SELECT quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.95)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (
    SELECT idx, if(idx <= length(anyb), anyb[idx], inf) AS bound,
           toFloat64(sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum
    FROM (
      SELECT bounds AS anyb, idx, sum(deltas[idx]) AS delta FROM (
        SELECT ExplicitBounds AS bounds, deltas, arrayJoin(range(1, length(deltas) + 1)) AS idx FROM samples WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
      ) GROUP BY anyb, idx
    )
  )
) WHERE isFinite(value)

SELECT if(sum(d) > 0, sumIf(d, Attributes['status'] = 'succeeded') / sum(d), 0) AS value FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.runs' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND now()
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

SELECT sum(d) AS value FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.cost' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND now()
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT if(max_ts > 0, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp(now()) - max_ts), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT max(v) AS max_ts FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.last_progress_timestamp' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes))

SELECT time, concat(role, ' ', model, ' ', status) AS series, 60 * value AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, role, model, status, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['role'] AS role, Attributes['model'] AS model, Attributes['status'] AS status, d
    FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.runs' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
  ) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, role, model, status
) ORDER BY time, series

WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.run.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime

SELECT time, concat('p50', ' ', role, ' ', model) AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT time, role, model, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.5)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (
    SELECT time, role, model, idx, if(idx <= length(anyb), anyb[idx], inf) AS bound,
           toFloat64(sum(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY time, role, model ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum
    FROM (
      SELECT time, bounds AS anyb, role, model, idx, sum(deltas[idx]) AS delta FROM (
        SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['role'] AS role, Attributes['model'] AS model, ExplicitBounds AS bounds,
               deltas, arrayJoin(range(1, length(deltas) + 1)) AS idx FROM samples WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
      ) GROUP BY time, anyb, role, model, idx
    )
  ) GROUP BY time, role, model
) WHERE isFinite(value) ORDER BY time, series

WITH samples AS (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((c, p) -> if(c >= p, toFloat64(c) - toFloat64(p), toFloat64(c)), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS deltas
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.turn.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT time, concat('p95', ' ', role, ' ', model) AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT time, role, model, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.95)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (
    SELECT time, role, model, idx, if(idx <= length(anyb), anyb[idx], inf) AS bound,
           toFloat64(sum(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY time, role, model ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum
    FROM (
      SELECT time, bounds AS anyb, role, model, idx, sum(deltas[idx]) AS delta FROM (
        SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['role'] AS role, Attributes['model'] AS model, ExplicitBounds AS bounds,
               deltas, arrayJoin(range(1, length(deltas) + 1)) AS idx FROM samples WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
      ) GROUP BY time, anyb, role, model, idx
    )
  ) GROUP BY time, role, model
) WHERE isFinite(value) ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, concat(model, ' ', type) AS series, value AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, model, type, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['model'] AS model, Attributes['type'] AS type, d
    FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.tokens' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
  ) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, model, type
) ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, concat(tool, ' ', outcome) AS series, 60 * value AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, tool, outcome, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['tool'] AS tool, Attributes['outcome'] AS outcome, d
    FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.agent.tool.calls' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
  ) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, tool, outcome
) ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, concat(service, ' ', method, ' ', status) AS series, value AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, method, status, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['service'] AS service, Attributes['http.request.method'] AS method, Attributes['http.response.status_code'] AS status, d
    FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.http.server.requests' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
  ) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, service, method, status
) ORDER BY time, series

WITH samples AS (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((c, p) -> if(c >= p, toFloat64(c) - toFloat64(p), toFloat64(c)), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS deltas
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'colony.http.server.request.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT time, concat('p95', ' ', service) AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.95)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (
    SELECT time, service, idx, if(idx <= length(anyb), anyb[idx], inf) AS bound,
           toFloat64(sum(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY time, service ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum
    FROM (
      SELECT time, bounds AS anyb, service, idx, sum(deltas[idx]) AS delta FROM (
        SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['service'] AS service, ExplicitBounds AS bounds,
               deltas, arrayJoin(range(1, length(deltas) + 1)) AS idx FROM samples WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
      ) GROUP BY time, anyb, service, idx
    )
  ) GROUP BY time, service
) WHERE isFinite(value) ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, concat('RSS ', service_name) AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'colony.process.memory.rss' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime
  GROUP BY time, Attributes, Attributes['service_name']
) ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, concat('heap ', service_name) AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'colony.process.memory.heap_used' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime
  GROUP BY time, Attributes, Attributes['service_name']
) ORDER BY time, series
